title: Many signals, no shared voice

derivation.method: Original visual interpretation of canon-traced propositions
derivation.transformation: Abstract vector pathway diagram; no empirical data

scopeLimits: This diagram does not claim that all markets work the same way or that people should coordinate.
limitations: Conceptual visual; no observed dataset or empirical telemetry.

accessibility.altText: Abstract individual points follow different paths toward separate offer surfaces. Some points have overlapping markers, but they are not merged into a group.
accessibility.textEquivalent: Independent participant searches route to siloed supplier offer surfaces without forming shared positions or demand-side representation.
